players.bio: Alistair Oluwashaun Smith (born 19 May 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.

Andrew Kyere Yiadom (born 2 December 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Born in England, he plays for the Ghana national team. Club career Early career Yiadom was born in Holloway, Greater London. He started his career in the youth team of Watford but wasn't offered a professional contract at the end of his scholarship.

Aron Kwame Jolle Sasu (born 5 March 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Born in England, he has been called up to represent Norway at youth level.
Callum Maycock (born 23 December 1997) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.
Daniel Liam Sweeney (born 25 April 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.
Delano McCoy-Splatt (born 11 October 2004) is a footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Born in England, he is a Jamaica international.
Donnell Ocarriel McNeilly (born 30 October 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for AFC Wimbledon on loan from Premier League club Nottingham Forest.

Dujuan Odile Richards (born 10 November 2005) is a Jamaican professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon on loan from Premier League club Chelsea and the Jamaica national team.

Freddie James Simmonds (born 9 March 2008) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon, on loan from the academy of Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.

Harry Charles Frederick Cornick is an English professional footballer who plays as a right winger or centre-forward for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. He started his career at Christchurch before joining Bournemouth in 2013. While at Bournemouth, he had numerous loans at clubs across the National League, League Two and League One before joining Luton for an undisclosed fee in 2017.
Isaac Ifeoluwa Foloronso Olushore Ogundere (born 6 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.[
James Tilley (born 13 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who currently plays as a defender for AFC Wimbledon in EFL League One.
Jayden Connor Stockley (born 15 September 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.

Joseph Patrick McDonnell (born 19 May 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for AFC Wimbledon. McDonnell came through the ranks at Basingstoke Town under the guidance of academy manager Jason Bristow, who gave him his first contract after playing amateur cricket up until around the age of 16 or 17.

John Alec Jackson (born 15 August 1982) is an English professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder or as a defender. He is the current manager of League Two club AFC Wimbledon.

Josef John Bursik is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon on loan from EFL Championship club Portsmouth. Club career Stoke City Bursik began his career with the youth academy at AFC Wimbledon before joining Stoke City on 1 July 2017. Bursik spent time on loan at Hednesford Town and AFC Telford United.

Marcus Alexander Browne (born 18 December 1997) is an English professional footballer who currently plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. A product of the West Ham United youth academy, he can play in a central attacking midfield role and can also operate on both wings.
Mathew Antony Stevens (born 12 February 1998) is an English footballer and former amateur boxer who plays as a forward for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.

Myles Elliot Zach Hippolyte (born 9 November 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Born in England, he represents Grenada at international level.

Nathan James Bishop (born 15 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. He has previously played in the English Football League for Southend United and Mansfield Town.
Ollie Harrison is a 19-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder. He is currently on a season-long loan at AFC Wimbledon from Premier League club Chelsea.

Ryan Anthony Johnson (born 2 October 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Johnson began his career in the youth academy at West Bromwich Albion before joining Stevenage of League One in 2013. He made his first-team debut in May 2014 and in doing so became the club's youngest player in the English Football League.
Steven Jeffrey Seddon is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.
Zack Nelson (born 21 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon.

Zeze Steven Sessegnon is a professional footballer who plays as a defender or midfielder for EFL League One club AFC Wimbledon. Born in England, he represents the Turks and Caicos Islands at international level.
